WITH dpe_fg AS (
         SELECT diagnostics_dpe.numero_dpe,
            diagnostics_dpe.date_etablissement_dpe,
            diagnostics_dpe.annee_construction,
            diagnostics_dpe.surface_habitable,
            diagnostics_dpe.etiquette_dpe,
            diagnostics_dpe.type_installation_chauffage,
            diagnostics_dpe.code_postal,
            diagnostics_dpe.code_departement,
            diagnostics_dpe."position"
           FROM diagnostics_dpe
          WHERE ((diagnostics_dpe.etiquette_dpe = ANY (ARRAY['F'::bpchar, 'G'::bpchar])) AND (diagnostics_dpe."position" IS NOT NULL) AND ((diagnostics_dpe.code_departement)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['44'::character varying, '33'::character varying])::text[])) AND (diagnostics_dpe.surface_habitable > (0)::numeric) AND (diagnostics_dpe.surface_habitable < (10000)::numeric))
        ), dpe_with_parcelle AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.numero_dpe) d.numero_dpe,
            d.date_etablissement_dpe,
            d.annee_construction,
            d.surface_habitable,
            d.etiquette_dpe,
            d.type_installation_chauffage,
            d.code_postal,
            d.code_departement,
            p.id_parcelle,
            p.commune,
            p.contenance,
            d."position"
           FROM (dpe_fg d
             JOIN parcelles p ON (st_intersects(p.geometrie, d."position")))
          ORDER BY d.numero_dpe, p.contenance DESC
        ), last_mutation AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (mutations.id_parcelle) mutations.id_parcelle,
            mutations.date_mutation AS date_derniere_vente,
            mutations.valeur_fonciere AS prix_derniere_vente,
            mutations.adresse_numero,
            mutations.adresse_nom_voie
           FROM mutations
          WHERE (mutations.id_parcelle IS NOT NULL)
          ORDER BY mutations.id_parcelle, mutations.date_mutation DESC
        )
 SELECT dp.numero_dpe,
    dp.date_etablissement_dpe AS date_dpe,
    dp.annee_construction,
    dp.surface_habitable,
    dp.etiquette_dpe,
    dp.type_installation_chauffage AS type_chauffage,
    dp.code_postal,
    dp.code_departement,
    dp.commune,
    dp.id_parcelle,
    dp.contenance,
    lm.date_derniere_vente,
    lm.prix_derniere_vente,
    concat_ws(' '::text, lm.adresse_numero, lm.adresse_nom_voie) AS adresse,
    dp."position"
   FROM (dpe_with_parcelle dp
     LEFT JOIN last_mutation lm ON (((dp.id_parcelle)::text = (lm.id_parcelle)::text)));
